summary: Frontend-only i18n regression testing for Arabic (RTL) plus FR/EN regressions. All translation work validated: Header desktop+mobile in AR RTL, Footer fully AR (Navigation / Documents / Contact / legal fallback / copyright), quote & partner accordions fully AR with correct submit buttons, quote lang switcher shows 5 flags including SA, and FR/EN footers preserve expected wording. Zero raw i18n keys visible, zero JS console errors on /?lang=ar and /?lang=fr.

ui_bugs.issue: The mobile burger toggle button has no data-testid and no aria-label (2 last buttons in header have testid=null, aria=null). Menu works but is hard to target for automated tests.

issues: Country dial-code selector list still hardcoded in French (e.g. 'Luxembourg', 'Macédoine du Nord', 'Madagascar', 'Maroc'...). Not part of this iteration's scope but visible after opening 'كن شريكاً' in AR — country names remain latin/French while the form UI is Arabic.

action_items: (Optional) Add data-testid="mobile-menu-toggle" and aria-label to the mobile burger button in Header.jsx for future automation.
(Optional, out of current scope) Translate PartnerForm country dial-code list — currently only French labels are shown regardless of language.
critical_code_review_comments: AR translations are complete for header/footer/quote/partner as required; RTL (dir=rtl) applied on <html> correctly.
Brand names correctly preserved as latin per product decision (COMMUNITYPLACE, KDMARCHÉ, O'SCOP, LOGI'SCOP), with translated descriptor (« LOGI'SCOP — حاسبة الشحن »).
Legal fallback FooterLegalEntities renders «مساران شفافان…» in AR as expected.
FR and EN regressions clean — 'DEMANDE DE CONTACT'/'CONTACT REQUEST' appear uppercase due to CSS text-transform (matches originals).

Only 1 auth button visible in header (تسجيل الدخول). If both 'Connexion' AND 'Espace client' are expected for logged-out visitors, verify — currently only Login shows (likely intentional: Espace client shown only when authenticated).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full AR/FR/EN header+footer i18n validated on preview URL. Testids for language switcher: data-testid=language-{fr|en|es|gcf|ar}. Footer testids: footer-quote-toggle, footer-partner-toggle, quote-lang-switcher. Mobile burger button lacks testid but is the last visible button in <header>. No console errors detected.
